params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a basement MMA gym. SCENE: late night, 11 pm, after closing. Most of the fluorescent fixtures are off; only the four small spotlights over the cage and one fluorescent fixture near the mats are on, so the far parts of the room fade into warm dark grey shadow with the heavy bags as dark silhouettes. On the blue mat at the edge of the cage, the head coach: a 38-year-old Korean man, a retired pro champion, 175 cm with a lean hard bantamweight build, an oval face with a clean strong jawline, straight nose, straight medium-thick eyebrows and calm narrow eyes, black hair parted at the side and swept back with a soft fringe falling to one side, short at the sides; plain dark grey gym t-shirt, black training pants with a thin white side stripe, rubber slippers, a white towel around his neck in slippers holds up a pair of focus mitts at chest height, half-lit, calling a combination; the player character, seen from behind at the lower left, is mid-punch into the mitt with a small ink impact mark. A towel and a water bottle lie on the mat, the office window at the back is dark. Quiet, focused, intimate mood. RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, beams, frames and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, mat seams). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. SETTING: a basement MMA gym under a busy street in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul: one big low room about 20 by 13 meters with a 3.2 m ceiling of exposed raw grey concrete (#B9B6AF) with square concrete beams, two round grey ventilation ducts and a few conduit pipes; rows of cool-white twin-tube fluorescent light fixtures (#EAF0EC) hanging on short rods, their light slightly greenish; walls with a dark grey-green painted lower band (#4F5B55) about 1.2 m high and a cream upper wall (#E3D5B8); black rubber floor with pale speckles (#3A3A3A); a large area of interlocking puzzle mats in muted blue (#4A6B8A) with a cream border strip; one small black-steel octagonal cage about 6 m across with dark-red padded posts (#7A3A32), black chain-link mesh fence and an off-white canvas floor (#E8E2D6) raised one step; six heavy bags, black and dark red, hanging from a steel rail under a ceiling beam along one wall; a small weight corner with a barbell rack, dumbbell rack, flat bench, kettlebells, a tractor tire and a coiled battle rope; a small office in the corner with a big clear-glass window in an aluminium frame, inside a desk, an office chair, a steel cabinet, a champion belt mounted on a plain wooden plaque and one framed old fight poster that is only a picture with no text; a mirror wall; a row of grey steel lockers; a stand fan, a water dispenser, a wall round-timer box, a whiteboard on a stand, a steel shoe rack with a heap of rubber slippers, blank solid-color posters on the walls. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in props. CAMERA: third-person over-the-shoulder game camera, lens height about 1.7 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective. The reference image shows the player character: draw him small, seen from behind, standing at the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height; in the gym he wears a plain dark grey t-shirt and black shorts, barefoot. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. All posters, boards, banners and the belt plaque are blank solid color panels with at most simple abstract shapes: absolutely no letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.
